messages:
leah: FYI bank sent chargeback CB-1974201111 on MediaSync txn tx_MS77 ($6,300.00). Cardholder (AsterCorp) claims 'fraudulent / never received service'. Hold placed.
billing-bot: Automated: Chargeback CB-1974201111 created · merchant: MediaSync (mch_762) · evidence requested · payout hold applied · deadline: 7 days
tom: Can someone pull the transaction record and merchant evidence link? Need auth_time, acquirer_ref, last4, any invoices.
rachel: From ledger: 
```
transaction_id: tx_MS77
amount: 6300.00
currency: USD
auth_time: 2026-02-14T16:05:09Z
acquirer_ref: ACQ-b12f9
card_last4: 2468
merchant_id: mch_762
product: media-deliver-annual
```
leah: MediaSync uploaded invoice (invoice_2026-02-14.pdf) and an order confirmation email. They also attached CDN delivery logs showing content delivered 2026-02-14T16:06:12Z-16:07:33Z and signed delivery acceptance by account admin (s.sharma@astercorp.com). Link: https://redwood-internal/s3/evidence/mch_762/tx_MS77/packet.zip
billing-bot: Evidence uploaded by rachel: invoice_2026-02-14.pdf, order_email.eml, cdn_logs.csv, acceptance_signature.png · status: evidence_pending_review
tom: Merchant says account created via self-service with card on file—do we have IPs and account creation event? If fraudster used the card, merchant acceptance signature might be forged.
rachel: They included account creation IP 45.60.10.11 at 2026-02-14T15:59:58Z and an admin login from 45.60.10.11 at 16:02:03Z. Delivery logs show content retrieved from IPs matching AsterCorp corporate ASN.
leah: Risk flagged mismatch: acquirer returned MCC 7399 (business services) while merchant filed as 5734 (software). Also bank notes 'suspicious rapid downloads' in claim notes.
rachel: Legal asked MediaSync to provide signed SOW/PO or customer purchase email thread and a notarized statement if necessary. They say they have a signed acceptance image but can request origin metadata for the signature.
tom: Let's escalate to risk for geolocation/velocity check and to ops for MCC mapping weirdness. If evidence is solid, we should represent. If signature provenance is weak, banks may side with cardholder.
rachel: Risk-bot: Requesting geolocation analysis for IPs 45.60.10.11, 198.51.100.47 and ASN lookups.
rachel: Risk-bot responded: IP 45.60.10.11 maps to AsterCorp ASN (confirmed), 198.51.100.47 is a consumer ISP unrelated to AsterCorp. No immediate fraud pattern but further look recommended.
billing-bot: Reminder: representment window closes in 7 days. Current status: evidence_pending_review.
leah: MediaSync asked about reserve impact and whether we can propose a partial release. Risk-bot: Partial release requires risk approval; open a formal request with proposed amount and security tranche.
tom: I'll validate timestamps and docs. If everything lines up and the signed acceptance is timestamped and IP-matched to AsterCorp, we prepare representment packet: invoice, delivery logs, admin login + IP correlation, order confirmation email, signed acceptance image, CDN access hashes. Plan to submit in 48 hours.
rachel: Evidence uploaded to dispute CB-1974201111 by rachel: invoice_2026-02-14.pdf, order_email.eml, cdn_logs.csv, acceptance_signature.png, account_events.csv · status: evidence_ready_for_review
leah: Thanks — looping in legal and ops. Will update merchant and request notarized signature provenance if bank pushes back. :pray:
